question_text: A group of researchers is looking to study the effect of body weight on blood pressure in the elderly. Previous work measuring body weight and blood pressure at 2-time points in a large group of healthy individuals revealed that a 10% increase in body weight was accompanied by a 7 mm Hg increase in blood pressure. If the researchers want to determine if there is a linear relationship between body weight and blood pressure in a subgroup of elderly individuals in this study, which of the following statistical methods would best be employed to answer this question?
